description.html:
These products are composed of two layers of leaves with one food grade paper layer in between them. No colours, no chemicals, no preservatives are used for this manufacturing. Approximately 30 days are required for bio degradation of products. This Product also known as Patravali.

  • Renewable source as products are made from fallen dry leaves which otherwise is wasted.
  • Naturally degrades in less than 60 days after disposition in soil.
  • Products will break down and act as fertilizer after disposition.
  • Microwavable.
  • Heat resistant.
  • Easy to handle.
  • Used for both solid & liquid food.

description.html:
• SUSTAINABLE: Made from bamboo, this cone is a natural and nature-friendly alternative to paper and plastic serving cones.
  • DURABLE: Designed to hold medium-sized food servings like chicken tenders, fries, fruit, vegetables, and other bite-sized morsels.
  • A CREATIVE WAY TO SERVE: The unique and rustic design allows for a more fun and creative way to serve up some of your tastiest bite-sized fare.
  • VERSATILE: Ideal for food trucks, outdoor catered events, wedding receptions, cafes, or other establishments looking for a food-serving alternative to traditional bowls or plates.

description.html:
Practical and stylish box with detachable lid. Lid can also be used as a tray. Doesn’t trap condensation, so hot food stays crispy. Make it more attractive with your branding or marketing sleeve. Also serves to keep the box tightly shut. Bagasse is recycled sugarcane fibre.

  • Natural: Made from 100% natural fiber.
  • Non-toxic: No toxic substance or odour is released even in high temperature or in acid/alkalil condition, 100% food contact safety.
  • Microwaveable: Safe to be used in Microwave, Oven and Refrigerator.
  • Biodegradable & Compost-able: 100% Biodegrade within 2 months; wastes will decompose into CO2 and Water.
  • Recyclable: Renewable, reused to make Paper, reduce the need for Petroleum based materials.
  • Water & Oil Proof: 120°C hot oil and 100°C hot water resistant.
  • A+ Quality & Durability: Smooth surface and Superior Strength, Stack-able, Leak proof.

description.html:
Ecoware is made from biomass pulp derived from sugarcane waste (“bagasse”).
Sugarcane is a native crop of India and is annually renewable.

  • 100% Biodegradable
  • 100% Compostable
  • 100% Natural
  • Made from 100% renewable and reclaimed resources.
  • Made with sugarcane, a rapidly renewable resource.
  • Grease and cut resistant.
  • No binders, fillers, coating or liners
  • Can be used for hot and cold foods
  • Microwave safe up to +180 °C
  • Freezer safe up to – 20 °C

description.html:
What is “Oxo-Biodegradable” ?

  • Petroleum-based plastic + small amounts of metal salts.
  • Metals speed up fragmentation when exposed to oxygen and heat.
  • Shortens degradation from hundreds of years to months/years.
  • Biodegradation of remaining fragments debated.

description.html:
Designed to offer protection while breathing, these 3 Ply Face Masks helps filter out pollutants, chemicals, dust, and microbes from the air as they may cause spread of infection, germs etc. These masks are unisex and are made from good quality inner and outer Spunbound material with 25 GSM. Its 3 layered design ensures maximum comfort and easy breathability, even when worn for extended hours. The filter layer is made from Melt Blown material with 20 GSM. The three layers make filtration more reliable and promotes cleaner air to breathe while also preventing bacterial contact. The 3 Ply Mask is lightweight, biodegradable also features super soft elastic ear band or ear loops to keep the mask in place and suitable for everyone. The Face Mask is ideal for doctors, surgeons, dentists, dental assistants, nurses, landscapers, contractors, plumbers, exterminators, nail technicians, etc.

Features:-

  • Inner and outer layer made of Spunbound material with 25 GSM
  • Triple layer construction for maximum safety
  • Filter layer made from Melt Blown material with 20 GSM
  • Unisex mask, can be used by men & women
  • Features elastic ear loop to ensure perfect fit
  • Disposable, made for one time use to maintain hygiene
  • Lightweight and biodegradable
  • Can be used at home, in office, during traveling or walking
  • Offers powerful protection against dust, germs and air borne contaminants

Chlorhexidine Gluconate I.P                          2.5% V/V
Equivalent to Chlorhexidine Gluconate       0.5% w/v
Ethyl Alcohol I.P.                                              70% V/V
Inert Ingredients With Emolients & Moisturizers

salient Features

  1. Provides residual antimicrobial protection  to skin
  2. rapid & effective disinfection of skin
  3. excellent skin tolerance
  4. no post procedural staining of skin
  5. germ count on the hand remains low for several hours
  6. does not affect sweat functions
  7. destroy transient pathogens and resident skin

Area of Application

Isolation wards, Critical areas (ICCUs , AKD, O.T.) O.P.D Laboratories, Dispensaries, Day & Home care units

Precaution of usage

Keep out of reach of children.For external use only keep out of ear and eyes.Do not mix with detergents or other chemicals

  • Ideal for presenting your gifts or edibles such as cookies, cupcakes, candies, chocolates, macarons, dry fruits etc.
  • A transparent cover of the box which makes it look more elegant.
  • Perfect for gifting at birthdays, weddings and many other parties and events.
